publicReleaseNotes: Pantry 0.2.1 lets customers pay an invoice by card from its link on a Stripe account opened now. Stripe starts new accounts on its newest API version, which refused 0.2.0's Checkout with "The payment_method_types parameter is no longer supported", so the customer saw "Stripe refused the request" instead of the payment page. Pantry now sends the Stripe API version it is tested against (2026-09-30.endive) on every Stripe call and on the webhook it creates, and names card or ACH for a Checkout with allowed_payment_method_types; the payment, its allocation to the invoice and Stripe's fee are recorded as before, and a webhook made by 0.2.0 keeps working without reconnecting Stripe. US owners who offer ACH bank debit must turn on the US bank account payment method in Stripe's payment method settings. Credential-shaped values in test fixtures and the demo are marked synthetic, so a hosted change made from this source passes the platform's source check. No new migrations: on your own computer git pull and rer dev, hosted the hosted backup, git pull and rer deploy. The checkout pins rer 0.2.44.
agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.2.0 there are no new migrations; the ledger stays at 0023_connected. On your own computer: rer dev --stop, rer export --output exports/pantry-books-0.2.0.rer, git pull, rer dev (installs the pinned rer 0.2.44). Hosted: from the deploying checkout with its .rer folder and .env.pantry, rer queue hosted-backup -- node scripts/hosted-backup.mjs --env-file .env.pantry, git pull, rer deploy --env-file .env.pantry (add --environment NAME to both if one was used); rer export saves only local books, never use it for a hosted backup. Stripe stays connected: the key and the webhook 0.2.0 created keep working, because Pantry reads each Checkout back from Stripe with its pinned API version; reconnecting is not needed. A US owner who offers ACH must turn on the US bank account payment method in the Stripe Dashboard (Settings, Payment methods), or Stripe refuses an ACH Checkout with 'All types provided in allowed_payment_method_types are invalid'. From 0.1.0, follow the 0.2.0 instructions in release-history/0.2.0.json first (the 0.2.0 upgrade applies migrations 0015 to 0023). Do not reset or restore into the populated installation. Run rer verify and pnpm run verify:release --from v0.2.0 before adopting.
